Package ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.operator

Class SelectOperator

java.lang.Object
ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.operator.Operator
ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.operator.SelectOperator
public class SelectOperator extends Operator
* The SelectOperator class represents a relational algebra selection operation. It filters tuples from its child operator based on a specified boolean expression. This operator corresponds to the WHERE clause in SQL queries.
